providers.name: Ollama (Local)
providers.free_reality: Verified free: no registration, no card, no rate limits (requires local RAM).
providers.notes: 100% private & free offline models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Mistral, etc.).

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free_reality: Verified free: key works without a card for :free models, subject to per-minute/day rate limits (429).
providers.notes: Single key for 100+ models including :free tier models.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.free_reality: Verified free: developer credits after NVIDIA account registration; speed/limits vary by model.
providers.notes: Free developer credits for Nemotron / Llama / DeepSeek.

providers.name: LM Studio (Local)
providers.free_reality: Free local GUI runner: no card or registration (requires local RAM).

providers.name: OpenCode Free Models
providers.free_reality: Limited: requires separate opencode CLI and frequently hits 429 rate limits.

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
providers.free_reality: Restricted: strict RPM/TPM limits, some regions/accounts require billing, free tier may log prompts.

providers.name: Groq
providers.free_reality: Restricted: very tight tokens-per-minute cap; hits 429 quickly on code or long prompts.
providers.notes: Fast inference with tight free-tier caps.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.free_reality: Restricted: low daily request cap and small context window; only for small tests.
providers.notes: Access via GitHub Personal Access Token.

providers.name: Anthropic (Claude)
providers.free_reality: Paid only: requires credit card and prepaid balance.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.free_reality: Paid only: requires credit card and prepaid balance.
